blockers.description: The C: and D: mirror paths have matching SHA-256 evidence but are not proven to be separate physical/off-site media.
blockers.workaround: Keep restore rehearsal evidence valid but document production off-site NAS/cloud/external-drive setup as an operational gap.

human_actions_pending.action: Configure and verify a genuinely off-site backup target for production.
human_actions_pending.context: Current mirror rehearsal proves copy integrity and disposable restore, not physical-site independence.

decisions.decision: Every mutable EF load is performed inside the transaction runner operation and every operation supplies a database verifier.
decisions.rationale: EfTransactionRunner clears ChangeTracker on retry/commit verification; external tracked entities would otherwise be detached and could silently skip writes.

decisions.decision: Keep EnableRetryOnFailure disabled until the legacy UnitOfWork transaction API is removed and final gates pass.
decisions.rationale: The source scan must have exactly one BeginTransactionAsync in EfTransactionRunner before global transient retry is considered safe.

decisions.decision: Do not treat the C:/D: mirror as proven off-site storage.
decisions.rationale: Logical drive letters do not prove separate physical devices or sites.
